name: hcapp_selectSong
description: Records a song selection for an event in the interactive songbook. Any authenticated user who is RSVP'd (RsvpState >= 2, Removed = 0) to the event may call this. All selections are retained in HC.SongSession for history — this does not replace a previous selection. Returns three rowsets on success: a compact envelope, adHocData with song details for the Flutter caller plus metadata for the Azure Function fan-out, and a third rowset of FCM token recipients for the Azure Function to push a visible notification to. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the song is being selected for. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error (errorCode 1281, errorType 2).

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Song being selected. Must exist in HC.Song with Removed = 0. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error (errorCode 1282, errorType 2). Song-not-found returns errorCode 1284, errorType 2.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact error envelope on auth, validation, RSVP check, song-not-found, or insert failure: { success=0, errorCode, errorType }. Followed by StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with SuccessEnvelope.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact success envelope: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope. Followed by AdHocData at index 1 and FcmRecipients at index 2.
Returned at index 1 alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on any error. Mutually exclusive with AdHocData rowset.

rowsets.name: AdHocData
rowsets.description: Single row of non-sync data for the Flutter caller and the Azure Function. adHocDataId = 1 (constant sentinel per the adHocDataId pattern). Contains the song title, selector name, event/song IDs (lowercase), and the count of push recipients pre-computed at insert time. Mutually exclusive with StandardErrorResult rowset.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Sentinel value per the HC6 adHocDataId pattern — signals this is a non-sync data rowset.

columns.name: songTitle
columns.description: HC.Song.SongName for the selected song — used in the Flutter snackbar and push notification body.

columns.name: selectedByName
columns.description: Display name of the caller resolved via COALESCE(NULLIF(HashName,''), NULLIF(DisplayName,''), NULLIF(FirstName,''), 'Someone').

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: The event UUID as lowercase NVARCHAR(40). Used by the Azure Function to scope the push.

columns.name: songId
columns.description: The selected song UUID as lowercase NVARCHAR(40). Used by the Azure Function to include in the push payload.

columns.name: recipientCount
columns.description: Pre-computed count of distinct mobile FCM recipients who will receive the push notification. Matches the rowset 2 WHERE clause exactly.

rowsets.name: FcmRecipients
rowsets.description: One row per distinct FCM token for mobile devices eligible to receive the song-selected push notification. Consumed by the Azure Function for fan-out — not parsed by the Flutter client. Excludes users who have set notification preference to 'ignore' (2) entirely; excludes 'mute' (3) unless the user is physically at the run (AttendenceState 20-39). Effective preference cascades: event-level if non-zero, otherwise kennel-level.

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: HC.Device.FcmToken — Firebase Cloud Messaging token for the recipient device.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: HC.Device.UserId cast to lowercase NVARCHAR(40) — the recipient user ID.

columns.name: showNotification
columns.description: Always 1. Signals the Azure Function to send a visible (alert) notification, not a silent data-only push (iOS throttles silent pushes to ~3/hour).

sideEffects: Inserts one row into HC.SongSession (EventId, SongId, SelectedByUserId, SelectedAt).
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, RSVP check, song-not-found, or insert errors.

codeSmells.detail: HC.SongSession.Removed is declared as BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. The project standard is SMALLINT. The SP's companion hcapp_getCurrentSong filters WHERE ss.Removed = 0, which works via implicit conversion but the schema is inconsistent.
The local variable for OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) is named @procName_self rather than the standard @procName used across all other app SPs. Cosmetic inconsistency.

codeSmells.issue: recipientCount pre-computed with a separate COUNT query that duplicates rowset 2 logic
codeSmells.detail: The @recipientCount variable is computed by a separate SELECT COUNT before the INSERT, mirroring the rowset 2 WHERE clause. If the rowset 2 logic is ever modified without updating the COUNT query, the recipientCount value will diverge from the actual push count.
